parsed.reason: Description A says the early-return denial path stores refilled tokens without advancing updated_at, so repeated denied calls re-add the same elapsed interval and over-admit requests. Description B says any cost greater than capacity can never be satisfied because tokens are capped at capacity, so those requests are always denied. Both point near lines 69-71, but they identify different failures: one is over-refill leading to too many admissions, the other is an unsatisfiable cost exceeding burst.
